run.comparison: a20-joint minus a20-one; forced moves, identical hidden worlds, fixed continuation policy
run.selection: first joint-vs-one alpha20 changed choice per focal trajectory; first N per profile in ascending seeds
run.assumptions: Uniform hidden allocations conditional on observed no-stock passes for both opponents, ignoring policy-choice likelihood. Branch-opening semantics provisional.
run.limitations: Targeted positions from a20-one trajectories; deterministic bots, no block winner, finish-first not match win; counterfactual continuations not independent full-deal baselines.

pipConfound.definition: single to double sequence; discarded pip delta = joint discarded pip sum minus one discarded pip sum; equalPip delta=0; nearPip |delta|<=2; higherPip delta>=3
pipConfound.bootstrap: 3000 position resamples using LCG floor((x/2^32)*n), not x%n; unadjusted 95% CI; n<8 suppressed
pipConfound.confidence: Exploratory. Equal-pip subgroup may be sparse; matched hidden worlds are not independent positions; no causal or human-play generalization.

newFinding: Pip-controlled comparison is a diagnostic, not yet a validated universal rule. See exact-pip sample sizes and position-level intervals.
nextHypothesis: On independent seeds, deliberately discover >=30 equal-pip single-vs-double choices per opponent policy, compare retained connectors and next-player mobility with 128 matched hidden worlds; run Node CLI tests.
